A little note for you 🌷

Dear Mumma,

Happy Birthday, Mumma! 💗 I hope your special day brings you the kind of happiness that stays with you long after the candles are blown out. May your days be filled with laughter, your heart with peace, and your life with people and moments that remind you how precious you are. Thank you for being you — for the warmth you bring, the smiles you share, and the memories that make this little journey brighter. You deserve kindness, beautiful surprises, and countless reasons to smile, today and always. May this new year of your life open the door to lovely opportunities, sweet adventures, and dreams coming true. Keep being your wonderful self, and never forget that you matter more than words can say.
With lots of love and birthday wishes, 💕
